topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Finding this time capsule was a gentle surprise, like stumbling upon an old photograph in a dusty attic. At first, I wondered how it could have slipped my memory, but I quickly realized that time has a way of tucking away our memories like leaves under the earth, only to reveal them when the moment is right. I sat down beside the capsule, taking a moment to think about when it might have been buried and by whom. Opening it slowly, piece by piece, felt like unfolding a story letter by letter. Each item, though faded or tarnished, told a tale, a fragment of a life once lived, now resonating with the past, present, and perhaps even the future.
